podcast.body: The Georgia Satellites' song "Revolution" was initially considered by Nike for their 1987 "Air Revolution" commercial. However, an editor at the ad agency Wieden+Kennedy ultimately opted to use The Beatles' song instead. "At first, Nike was going to use another song called Revolution by the Georgia satellites."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
srcs.episode: The Concept of Selling Out: Part 1
